title: Projektetage Enlarge Exit Restore
description: When pressing enlarge on figures/pdf in projektetage then pressing smaller (exit enlarge), nothing happens. Must restore the pre-enlarge disposition frame (including drag/resize), not the original declared frame.
summary:
Fixed dead exit-enlarge (smaller) control when a disposition is enlarged.

Root cause: slide reset hotspot host (`z-index: 70`, 5rem top-right) sat above enlarged dispositions (`z-index: 50`) and used `pointer-events: auto` on the whole hotspot, swallowing hover/clicks on the enlarge button.

Fix: `pointer-events: none` on slide-reset host (button still receives events when visible via `--near`), raise enlarged disposition action bar to `z-index: 80`, keep exit-enlarge controls visible while enlarged even if selection cleared, retain pre-enlarge stash restore from prior work.

108 renderer tests pass.
